title: Bombastic
body:
Description


Bombastic is a relatively uncommon ore found only in the Classic Biome, where the Classic Store is located, both located off the shore of Ferwater Island.

When Refined and forged, Bombastic takes on a honeycomb-like appearance.

Referring to Roblox Texture Series - Bombastic

The ore was introduced with Oakland's 2nd anniversary.

Also, the raw ore appears to be similar to copper.

Bombastic has a special property: The forged version doesn't say "Forged Bombastic", it says "Omeaga Bombastic".
